description: This file contains utility functions for file system operations such as copying directory trees, replacing directory contents, staging directory contents, and moving paths with fallback. It manages concurrency and excludes certain directories from operations.

methods.name: createExcludeMatcher
methods.description: Creates a function to check if a directory name should be excluded based on a list.

methods.name: createConcurrencyLimiter
methods.description: Creates a limiter to control the number of concurrent filesystem operations.

methods.name: lstatIfExists
methods.description: Performs lstat on a path, returns null if it fails.

methods.name: copyTreeWithoutSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively copies files and directories from source to target, skipping symlinks.

methods.name: replaceDirectoryContents
methods.description: Replaces the contents of a target directory with those from a source directory, excluding specified directories.

methods.name: stageDirectoryContents
methods.description: Copies contents from source to target directory, excluding specified directories, for staging purposes.

methods.name: movePathWithCopyFallback
methods.description: Attempts to move a file or directory; if cross-device error occurs, copies and then deletes the source.
